name:
Inazuma Eleven® GO
Chrono Stone: Thunderflash
formal_name:
Inazuma Eleven® GO
Chrono Stone: Thunderflash
description:
In this huge football RPG, the player
stars as a young schoolboy, Arion
Sherwind, who discovers football has
been erased from existence by an evil
organisation from the future! Recruit
the ultimate squad, travel through
time, and win matches against rivals
to rediscover Arion's friends, and
restore football to its former glory in
Inazuma Eleven GO Chrono Stones:
Thunderflash on Nintendo 3DS and
2DS!
disclaimer:
The contents of the software are the same as the package version released on December 13, 2012 (price: 5,657 yen).
Due to the large amount of data, it may take a long time to download the software. Please download while charging your Nintendo 3DS.
